description: Python dependencies through uv, GitHub Actions and prek hooks from remote repositories. Weekly, with minor and patch updates grouped; versions younger than ten days are left out, as uv's exclude-newer refuses them.

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates into one weekly pull request; majors stay individual.
pymumble-rev is 0.x and pinned exactly (ADR-001): a minor release may break its API, so it never rides in the weekly batch.
onnxruntime publishes no wheel for Python 3.15 yet: Python stays on 3.14, in requires-python and .python-version, until it does.
